versions.content: If there was not enough space to copy the complete message to any of the assigned LogChannel’s buffer, DLT_E_NO_BUFFER shall be returned and the Dlt log and trace message shall be discarded. In addition, check each assigned buffer whether it was already full before, i.e., check Dlt internal flags to store a buffer overflow event:  If the buffer overflow flag is currently not set for this buffer: o Set the buffer overflow flag to indicate the occurrence of a buffer overflow o The Dlt log and trace message shall be discarded  If the buffer overflow flag for this buffer was already set for this buffer: o The Dlt log and trace message shall be discarded  Send Dlt Control Message(s) “BufferOverflowNotification” according to the configuration. Please refer to chapter 7.1.11.1.
